Package game.items.mine

Class Geode

java.lang.Object
edu.monash.fit2099.engine.GameEntity
edu.monash.fit2099.engine.items.Item
game.items.mine.Geode
All Implemented Interfaces:
Printable, Breakable
public class Geode extends Item implements Breakable
A geode. It can be picked up and carried, and can be broken either from the inventory or while it lies on the ground (from the tile it lies on). Either way the breaker is standing on the tile where it is broken, so the outcome is centred on that tile.

Breaking a geode removes it and either produces a diamond or makes it explode.
